name: mases
//: MASES Phase 2 UI — Production Package Manifest
Unit 0.1 (B) — Candidate Freeze Revision
ARCHITECTURE:
· One repository
· One package.json (this file, at repository root)
· One node_modules tree
· One shared design system
· Three independent static application builds
· No Node.js runtime in production
ENTRY POINTS:
· workspace-entry/   -> workspace application
· portal-entry/      -> portal application
· admin-entry/       -> admin application
BUILD OUTPUT:
· workspace build -> dist/
· portal build    -> dist-portal/
· admin build     -> dist-admin/
DEPLOYMENT:
· dist/        -> app.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/
· dist-portal/ -> portal.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/
· dist-admin/  -> admin.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/
TYPE SAFETY:
· vue-tsc is mandatory before every production build.
· The canonical standalone type-check script is `type-check`.
· Every `build:*` production target type-checks its own inputs
so that no build can be produced from unchecked TypeScript,
even when invoked directly (CI, Plesk, or a human operator).
· Do not introduce a `typecheck` alias merely for convenience.
BUILD SEMANTICS:
· `npm run build` is the canonical production build and produces
ALL THREE applications. It is the only build command that a
deployment pipeline should ever invoke.
· `build:all` runs type-check once, then the workspace Vite build,
then the portal Vite build, then the admin Vite build —
sequentially, fail-fast.
· `build:workspace`, `build:portal`, and `build:admin` are
self-defending: each runs type-check before its own Vite build,
so direct invocation remains policy-compliant. The aggregate
path avoids the double type-check by calling `vite build`
directly.
· `dev`, `dev:portal`, `dev:admin`, and `preview` are not
production targets and deliberately do not run vue-tsc.
PREVIEW:
· `preview` previews the workspace build (dist/).
· A portal preview target is intentionally deferred until
vite.config.ts is finalised. `vite preview` reads the output
directory from build config per mode; it does not accept an
--outDir runtime flag in Vite 6. The correct portal preview
mechanism (mode-driven outDir, or a second config) will be
locked together with vite.config.ts.
VERSION POLICY:
· All direct dependencies use exact x.y.z versions.
· No caret (^), tilde (~), wildcard (*), latest, or floating ranges.
· Existing candidate pins are preserved.
· Major-version upgrades require an explicit bounded architecture
decision recorded in the change log for this unit.
RUNTIME POLICY:
· engines.node and engines.npm are advisory guards that make
toolchain drift visible at install time. They are not a
substitute for a pinned packageManager field; Corepack-based
pinning will be introduced only after verifying that the
Plesk Node toolchain honours it.
VALIDATION POLICY:
· Unit 0.1 Part E validates this candidate manifest in a scratch
copy.
· Scratch validation may use npm install and vue-tsc directly.
· Plesk deployment must use the approved npm scripts only —
in particular `npm run build`, never ad-hoc vite invocations.
SECURITY:
· No secrets are stored in this manifest.
· VITE_API_BASE_URL is supplied through deployment environment
configuration.
· Note: VITE_-prefixed variables are inlined into the client
bundle at build time and must never carry secret material.
· Production hosting serves static assets only.
TOOLING DEFERRED (not part of this freeze):
· ESLint / Prettier / Vitest / Playwright / Renovate / Dependabot
· npm `overrides` (added only when a transitive dependency
requires an explicit pin).
· These are separate architecture decisions and must be
introduced through their own bounded change, not smuggled
into a manifest cleanup.
TEMPORARY REMEDIATION SCRIPTS (delete when type-check is green):
· fix:phase-1 — one-shot mechanical edits for the type-check
remediation batch. Invokes scripts/mases-fix-phase-1.cjs.
Not part of the frozen toolchain; not invoked by any build
or deployment target. Remove this script entry and the
scripts/ directory once vue-tsc reports zero errors.

scripts.build:workspace: npm run type-check && vite build --mode workspace
scripts.build:portal: npm run type-check && vite build --mode portal
scripts.build:admin: npm run type-check && vite build --mode admin
scripts.build:all: npm run type-check && vite build --mode workspace && vite build --mode portal && vite build --mode admin
